threat_summary: A report describes attackers attempting to load a vulnerable or unsigned driver to disable security tooling.
key_behaviors: driver file written to system path
security tool process stops soon after
hunt_checklist: Identify unsigned or vulnerable driver names.
Correlate with security service stop events.
List hosts with same driver hash.
correlation_logic: Correlate behavior on the same host/user within a 24-hour window unless the report specifies a narrower time range.
escalation_condition: Escalate when driver load is followed by security tool tampering or service stops.
analyst_notes: Generated as synthetic gold output for MVP evaluation. Queries should be reviewed against the real SIEM/EDR schema.
